concerns.text: The plan cites three InstructPix2Pix parquet shards as the raw prompt source (see ‘Download & verify three open InstructPix2Pix parquet shards (balanced 1 000‑prompt set)’). InstructPix2Pix provides single‑step editing instructions and does not contain naturally occurring *conflicting* instructions required to evaluate the hypothesis that a symbolic constraint‑graph layer mitigates degradation on *conflicting* prompts. Using this dataset risks an invalid test of the core research question; a dataset explicitly containing multi‑step or contradictory editing instructions (or a curated subset with verified conflicts) is needed.
